# OriginsMeta

> Unofficial companion site for Origins TCG, the digital trading card game by Koin Games: news, tier list, guides, the full card database, community decks and a tournament calendar, in English, Italian and Spanish.

OriginsMeta is a fan project run by players and is not affiliated with Koin Games. For rules, dates and announcements the official sources always win; everything here is sourced from them and says so on the page.

Origins TCG is a digital trading card game by Koin Games, a studio based in Tampa, Florida, founded in 2021. Its cast is made of public-domain legends — Robin Hood, Mulan, the Queen of Hearts, Dracula and many more — reimagined in one original world. The game is presented as free-to-compete: every card needed to play competitively is earned by playing, and money only buys collectible versions of cards. A free demo is available on Steam.

Card data on this site follows the latest published patch — at the time of writing, the demo patch of 21 September 2026, with all 122 demo cards checked one by one in the game on 22 September 2026 — and is updated when a new patch changes it, so stats and card text move with the game rather than staying fixed at one version. Every page states the patch its numbers come from.

Community decks are written by players in their own language; the site translates each deck guide automatically into the other two languages and says so on the translated page, with a link to the author's original.

## Key facts (checked on 25 September 2026)

- Release: the Steam store page says "Q4 2026", with no exact date. No early access has been announced.
- Demo: the free Demo 2.0 has been on Steam since 21 September 2026, when the first big demo update arrived (new interface and board, test packs, voice lines, balance changes). Ranked mode opens with the Steam Next Fest, 19–26 October 2026. Guide: [How to play the demo](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/play-the-demo).
- Crimson Cup: the official tournament of the Next Fest, from 20 to 25 October 2026, played on the demo. The format is three-deck Conquest with at least 8 unique cards between each pair of decks, and decklists stay hidden until the top 4. Summary in the next section; rules: [Crimson Cup format and check-in](https://originsmeta.com/en/news/crimson-cup-format-check-in).
- Kickstarter: the main menu of the demo shows it as "Coming soon – Oct 27" (read on 25 September 2026). No official post confirms the date yet. Pre-registration is open: a refundable $1 deposit gives 15% off, and the Alpha boxes are preorder-only. Guide: [Origins TCG Kickstarter](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/origins-tcg-kickstarter).
- Languages: Steam lists English, French, Italian and German for the interface, with full audio in English only. The demo also has the interface and the card texts in Spanish (checked in the game on 25 September 2026), which Steam does not list yet.
- Platforms: the Steam page lists Windows and macOS. Mobile is not out: on its pre-registration page (founder.origins-tcg.com) Koin Games writes "Mobile pack opening is coming! We have our sights set on 2027 for Origins on Mobile." (read on 25 September 2026). Neither page says whether that means Android, iOS or both.
- Demo progress: according to the Steam post of 21 September 2026, whoever played the demo, the playtest or both keeps whichever progress is further ahead. The exclusive demo collectibles become tradeable on the Steam marketplace when the full game launches (Steam post of 16 July 2026).
- Not Riftbound: "Riftbound Origins" is a card set of Riftbound, the League of Legends trading card game (official Riftbound site, read on 25 September 2026). Origins TCG by Koin Games is a different game.
- Deck rules: one Legendary plus twelve different base cards, two copies each, for 25 cards. Deck codes of the game start with KGBLDC: the deck builder imports them and exports them.
- Answers to the most common questions, each with its source and date: [FAQ](https://originsmeta.com/en/faq).
- Dates and roadmap: [Roadmap and dates](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/roadmap-and-dates). Next Fest: [Steam Next Fest 2026 guide](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/steam-next-fest-2026).

## Crimson Cup rules in brief

The official Origins TCG tournament of Steam Next Fest, run by Koin Games (announcements of 9 and 24 September 2026). Full rules and times: [Crimson Cup rules](https://originsmeta.com/en/news/crimson-cup-format-check-in).

- When and where: 20–25 October 2026, entirely online and in the game, on the main demo (not on the playtest). Three qualifiers of 512 spots each: EMEA on 20 October at 7pm CEST, AMER on 21 October at 7pm EST, APAC on 22 October at 7pm SGT; players can join any qualifier, wherever they live. Playoffs on 24 October (256 spots), finals on 25 October.
- Format: Conquest with three decks, each led by a different Legendary, with at least 8 unique cards between each pair of decks. Decklists stay hidden until the top 4: in the ban you only see the Legendary.
- Matches: best of three, with a best-of-five grand final (announcement of 9 September). Best-of-five matches have no ban: you must win with all three decks.
- Check-in: opens two hours before each qualifier and closes five minutes before the start, together with deck submission. Miss it and you can't play.
- Prizes: worth $10,000 in total, not a cash pool: an exclusive 1/1 tournament promo card, other promo cards, digital packs, Alpha booster boxes and cases, and cash prizes. The exact prize pool was promised for the week after 24 September.
- Balance: the last balance patch before the tournament arrives two weeks before Steam Next Fest.
- Sign-ups on the [official Discord](https://discord.gg/originstcg). Guide to the festival: [Origins TCG at Steam Next Fest 2026](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/steam-next-fest-2026). The [deck builder](https://originsmeta.com/en/deck-builder) has a tournament mode that checks three decks against the Conquest rule.

## Legendaries

The 11 Legendaries of the Demo 2.0: every deck is led by one of them. Data of the latest patch (demo patch of 21 September 2026). Each card page is also in Italian (/it/cards/…) and Spanish (/es/cards/…) with the same slug, the official text in that language and the balance history.

- [Dorothy](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/dorothy): Legendary unit, 4 mana, 1 Power / 1 Health, Good. I can Move each round. I have +1 Power/+1 Health for each time an ally moved this game.
- [Dracula](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/dracula): Legendary unit, 4 mana, 3 Power / 2 Health, Evil. When you discard, return me from your graveyard to hand. On Reveal: Summon Brides of Dracula [2 Power/2 Health] on a random space here.
- [King Arthur](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/king-arthur): Legendary unit, 7 mana, 7 Power / 7 Health, Good. Shield. On Reveal: Give your Good characters Shield.
- [Legion of the Dead](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/legion-of-the-dead): Legendary spell, 7 mana, Neutral. Fill your board with Zombies [2 Power/2 Health].
- [Merlin](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/merlin): Legendary unit, 5 mana, 5 Power / 5 Health, Neutral. Repeat the first spell you play each round.
- [Mulan](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/mulan): Legendary unit, 4 mana, 2 Power / 4 Health, Good. Double Attack. When an ally On Reveal ability happens, repeat it.
- [Queen of Hearts](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/queen-of-hearts): Legendary unit, 4 mana, 3 Power / 3 Health, Evil. First Strike. When an ally On Death ability happens, repeat it.
- [Robin Hood](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/robin-hood): Legendary unit, 8 mana, 4 Power / 4 Health, Good. Snipe 3. On Reveal: Deal 2 damage to all enemies.
- [Three Not So Little Pigs](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/three-not-so-little-pigs): Legendary unit, 7 mana, 3 Power / 3 Health, Neutral. Trample. On Reveal: Summon a Not So Little Pig [3 Power/3 Health] with Trample on a random space at each other location.
- [Van Helsing](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/van-helsing): Legendary unit, 4 mana, 3 Power / 4 Health, Good. Before combat, add Van Helsing's Tools to your hand if it is not already there.
- [Wicked Stepmother](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/wicked-stepmother): Legendary unit, 4 mana, 4 Power / 6 Health, Evil. Deathtouch. On Reveal: Give your Evil characters Deathtouch.

## English pages

- [Home](https://originsmeta.com/en): what is new across the site — news, calendar, tier list and MetaShifting.
- [FAQ](https://originsmeta.com/en/faq): the answers we have written and checked, each with its source and date: release date, languages, mobile, demo progress, ranked mode, the Legendaries, deck codes, the Crimson Cup and the Kickstarter.
- [Tier list](https://originsmeta.com/en/tier-list): decks, Legendaries and base cards; the OriginsMeta ranking starts after the Crimson Cup (20–25 October 2026), built on tournament results.
- [Most played](https://originsmeta.com/en/tier-list/most-played): how many of the decks published on OriginsMeta use each Legendary and card, with the deck archetypes. Popularity, not a win rate.
- [Community tier list](https://originsmeta.com/en/tier-list/community): the average of the tier lists saved by members, with votes per card; a preview until 5 lists.
- [Tier list maker](https://originsmeta.com/en/tier-list/create): make your own Origins TCG tier list by dragging the Demo 2.0 cards into tiers S to D, with the Legendaries on their own list, and share it with a link. Free, no account needed.
- [MetaShifting](https://originsmeta.com/en/metashifting): Origins TCG patch notes: every balance change, card by card and patch by patch, newest first, taken from Koin Games' official posts.
- [Card list](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards): every Demo 2.0 card with current stats, the official text in English, Italian and Spanish as it reads in the game, balance history and the legend it comes from.
- [Locations](https://originsmeta.com/en/locations): the locations of the Demo 2.0 with their effects, searchable and filterable.
- [Decks](https://originsmeta.com/en/decks): deck lists published by the community from the deck builder, each with a guide and 1–5 star ratings.
- [Deck builder](https://originsmeta.com/en/deck-builder): build a legal deck in the browser — one Legendary plus twelve different base cards in two copies each, 25 cards — then export the game code or publish the list. Free, no account needed to build.
- [Guides](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides): how the game works, the roadmap, the collector economy, how to play the demo, deck guides and matchups.
- [Tournaments and events](https://originsmeta.com/en/tournaments): official and community events, plus the community tournament organizer.
- [News](https://originsmeta.com/en/news): official announcements, demo updates, events and the decks published on the site; every patch also has its own article. Every item has its own signed article page, with the date, the official source and the cards it touches.
- [Who writes here](https://originsmeta.com/en/authors): the people who sign the guides, the decks and the news, and what each of them covers.
- [About](https://originsmeta.com/en/about): who we are, how we work and which sources we use.

## Guides

Every OriginsMeta guide in English, the game first and then the deck guides; each one is also in Italian (/it/guides/…) and Spanish (/es/guides/…) with the same slug.

- [Origins TCG locations: how the three lanes change every game](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/origins-tcg-locations): Locations are the third player at the table: they double damage, change costs and move your characters. How they work, which ones decide games, and how to build with them in mind.
- [How to download and play the Origins TCG demo on Steam](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/play-the-demo): The free demo in five steps: requirements, download, language, first matches, what demo players unlock and what the 21 September update brought.
- [Origins TCG explained in five minutes](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/origins-tcg-explained): What Origins TCG is, how a match works across three lanes with simultaneous turns, what free-to-compete means and how to play the demo today.
- [Origins TCG at Steam Next Fest 2026: Demo 2.0, dates and the tournament](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/steam-next-fest-2026): Origins TCG at Steam Next Fest, 19–26 October 2026: ranked mode in the demo, the Crimson Cup from 20 to 25 October, the prizes and how to sign up.
- [Roadmap and dates: from the demo to launch](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/roadmap-and-dates): Every confirmed Origins TCG date, from the first Steam post to the Demo 2.0 update and the Crimson Cup at Next Fest, plus what is planned for 2027.
- [Is Origins TCG pay-to-win? Free-to-compete, explained](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/is-origins-tcg-pay-to-win): Koin Games sells Origins TCG as the first free-to-compete card game with zero pay-to-win. What money actually buys, and the honest caveats.
- [Origins TCG Kickstarter: date, pre-registration, Alpha Edition and what we know](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/origins-tcg-kickstarter): The demo menu shows the Kickstarter as “Coming soon – Oct 27”. Pre-registration is open: 15% off for a refundable 1 dollar deposit, preorder-only Alpha boxes.
- [Two ways to collect: how the Origins economy works](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/collector-economy): Competitive cards are free. Collector cards are limited, graded and tradeable on Steam. Here is what is confirmed and what is not.
- [On Reveal Mid Range: how to play the Mulan midrange deck](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/on-reveal-midrange-guide): Game plan, mulligan and round-by-round play for On Reveal Mid Range, the Mulan deck that repeats every On Reveal ability, for ladder, competitive and tournaments.
- [King of Value Trade: how to play the King Arthur midrange deck](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/king-of-value-trade-guide): Game plan, mulligan and round-by-round play for King of Value Trade, the King Arthur midrange deck built to win every trade two cards for one.
- [Dorothy Combo: how to play the move deck after the 21 September patch](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/dorothy-combo-guide): The move deck rebuilt around the 21 September buffs: how Dorothy grows, which combos to look for, the mulligan and what the list still cannot do.
- [The Trick-or-Treat Legion: how to play the Legion of the Dead deck](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/trick-or-treat-legion-guide): The Legion of the Dead list built to be unpredictable: how the Zombie board works, the Golden Egg and Boogeyman combo, the mulligan and the matchups.
- [3 Pigs Mid Range: how to play the Three Not So Little Pigs midrange deck](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/three-pigs-midrange-guide): Game plan, mulligan and round-by-round play for 3 Pigs Mid Range, the midrange deck led by Three Not So Little Pigs, for ladder and competitive.
- [3 Pigs Mid Range: matchups, key interactions and Conquest](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/three-pigs-midrange-matchups): Part two of the 3 Pigs Mid Range guide: the interactions that win games, how to play the main matchups, the mistakes to avoid and Conquest.
- [Healing Healsing: how to play the Van Helsing control deck](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/healing-healsing-guide): Game plan, mulligan and round-by-round play for Healing Healsing, the Van Helsing control deck that heals, draws and resets the board.
- [Healing Healsing: matchups, key interactions and mistakes to avoid](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/healing-healsing-matchups): Part two of the Healing Healsing guide: the healing and card-draw interactions, the main matchups, the mistakes that lose to aggro, Conquest.

## Pagine in italiano

- [Home](https://originsmeta.com/it): le novità del sito — news, calendario, tier list e MetaShifting.
- [FAQ](https://originsmeta.com/it/faq): le risposte che abbiamo scritto e verificato, ognuna con la fonte e la data: data di uscita, lingue, mobile, progressi della demo, classificata, Leggendarie, codici dei mazzi, Crimson Cup e Kickstarter.
- [Tier list](https://originsmeta.com/it/tier-list): mazzi, Leggendarie e carte base; la classifica di OriginsMeta parte dopo la Crimson Cup (20–25 ottobre 2026), sui risultati dei tornei.
- [Le più giocate](https://originsmeta.com/it/tier-list/most-played): in quanti dei mazzi pubblicati su OriginsMeta compare ogni Leggendaria e ogni carta, con gli archetipi dei mazzi. Popolarità, non win rate.
- [Tier list della community](https://originsmeta.com/it/tier-list/community): la media delle tier list salvate dagli iscritti, con i voti per carta; un'anteprima fino a 5 liste.
- [Crea la tua tier list](https://originsmeta.com/it/tier-list/create): la tua tier list di Origins TCG, trascinando le carte della Demo 2.0 nelle fasce da S a D, con le Leggendarie a parte, da condividere con un link. Gratis, senza account.
- [MetaShifting](https://originsmeta.com/it/metashifting): le patch notes di Origins TCG, cioè ogni bilanciamento, carta per carta e patch per patch, dal più recente, prese dai post ufficiali di Koin Games.
- [Lista carte](https://originsmeta.com/it/cards): tutte le carte della Demo 2.0 con statistiche attuali, testo ufficiale in inglese e in italiano, come nel gioco, storico dei bilanciamenti e la leggenda di origine.
- [Luoghi](https://originsmeta.com/it/locations): i luoghi della Demo 2.0 con il loro effetto, da cercare e filtrare.
- [Mazzi](https://originsmeta.com/it/decks): le liste pubblicate dalla community dal deck builder, ognuna con guida e voto da 1 a 5 stelle.
- [Deck builder](https://originsmeta.com/it/deck-builder): si costruisce un mazzo legale nel browser — una Leggendaria più dodici carte base diverse in due copie ciascuna, 25 carte — poi si esporta il codice del gioco o si pubblica la lista. È gratuito e per costruire non serve un account.
- [Guide](https://originsmeta.com/it/guides): come funziona il gioco, la roadmap, l'economia da collezione, come provare la demo, guide ai mazzi e matchup.
- [Tornei ed eventi](https://originsmeta.com/it/tournaments): eventi ufficiali e della community, più il gestore dei tornei della community.
- [News](https://originsmeta.com/it/news): annunci ufficiali, aggiornamenti della demo, eventi e i mazzi pubblicati sul sito; ogni patch ha anche il suo articolo. Ogni notizia ha la sua pagina firmata, con la data, la fonte ufficiale e le carte che tocca.
- [Chi scrive qui](https://originsmeta.com/it/authors): le persone che firmano le guide, i mazzi e le news, e di che cosa si occupa ciascuna.
- [Chi siamo](https://originsmeta.com/it/about): chi siamo, come lavoriamo e quali fonti usiamo.

## Páginas en español

- [Inicio](https://originsmeta.com/es): las novedades del sitio — noticias, calendario, tier list y MetaShifting.
- [FAQ](https://originsmeta.com/es/faq): las respuestas que hemos escrito y comprobado, cada una con su fuente y su fecha: fecha de lanzamiento, idiomas, versión móvil, progreso de la demo, clasificatoria, Legendarias, códigos de mazos, Crimson Cup y Kickstarter.
- [Tier list](https://originsmeta.com/es/tier-list): mazos, Legendarias y cartas base; la clasificación de OriginsMeta empieza después de la Crimson Cup (20–25 de octubre de 2026), con los resultados de los torneos.
- [Las más jugadas](https://originsmeta.com/es/tier-list/most-played): en cuántos de los mazos publicados en OriginsMeta aparece cada Legendaria y cada carta, con los arquetipos de los mazos. Popularidad, no win rate.
- [Tier list de la comunidad](https://originsmeta.com/es/tier-list/community): la media de las tier lists guardadas por los miembros, con los votos por carta; una vista previa hasta llegar a 5 listas.
- [Crea tu tier list](https://originsmeta.com/es/tier-list/create): tu propia tier list de Origins TCG, arrastrando las cartas de la Demo 2.0 a los tiers de S a D, con las Legendarias aparte, para compartirla con un enlace. Gratis, sin cuenta.
- [MetaShifting](https://originsmeta.com/es/metashifting): las notas del parche de Origins TCG: cada cambio de equilibrio, carta por carta y parche por parche, del más reciente al más antiguo, a partir de las publicaciones oficiales de Koin Games.
- [Lista de cartas](https://originsmeta.com/es/cards): todas las cartas de la Demo 2.0 con sus estadísticas actuales, el texto oficial en inglés y en español, como en el juego, el historial de cambios y la leyenda de la que viene cada una.
- [Ubicaciones](https://originsmeta.com/es/locations): las ubicaciones de la Demo 2.0 con su efecto, con búsqueda y filtros.
- [Mazos](https://originsmeta.com/es/decks): las listas publicadas por la comunidad desde el deck builder, cada una con su guía y una valoración de 1 a 5 estrellas.
- [Deck builder](https://originsmeta.com/es/deck-builder): construye un mazo legal en el navegador — una Legendaria más doce cartas base distintas con dos copias de cada una, 25 cartas — y luego exporta el código del juego o publica la lista. Gratis, sin cuenta para construir.
- [Guías](https://originsmeta.com/es/guides): cómo funciona el juego, la hoja de ruta, la economía de coleccionismo, cómo jugar la demo, guías de mazos y matchups.
- [Torneos y eventos](https://originsmeta.com/es/tournaments): eventos oficiales y de la comunidad, más el organizador de torneos de la comunidad.
- [Noticias](https://originsmeta.com/es/news): anuncios oficiales, actualizaciones de la demo, eventos y los mazos publicados en el sitio; cada parche tiene además su propio artículo. Cada noticia tiene su propia página firmada, con la fecha, la fuente oficial y las cartas a las que afecta.
- [Quién escribe aquí](https://originsmeta.com/es/authors): las personas que firman las guías, los mazos y las noticias, y de qué se ocupa cada una.
- [Quiénes somos](https://originsmeta.com/es/about): quiénes somos, cómo trabajamos y qué fuentes usamos.

Generated from the site's data at every deploy.
